text: Developing a mobile app involves more than just writing code. One of the first decisions is choosing between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built specifically for one system, like iOS or Android, and often offer better performance and smoother animations. Cross-platform tools, however, allow you to write one codebase for both, which saves time and money, though they may have slight limitations. Regardless of your choice, a responsive design is crucial. This means the layout must adapt perfectly to different screen sizes and orientations. Finally, you must consider distribution through app stores like the Apple App Store or Google Play, where strict guidelines and review processes can significantly impact your launch timeline.
